title: Commercial Printing｜冷烫、热烫、数字烫金怎么专业区分？ / Hot Foil vs Cold Foil vs Digital Foil

seo.title: Commercial Printing｜冷烫、热烫、数字烫金怎么专业区分？ / Hot Foil vs Cold Foil vs Digital Foil

content:
# 中文回答

商业印刷里提到 foil，必须先区分四个体系：传统热烫、冷烫、digital foil、toner reactive foil。它们的设备、胶层、温度和适配材料完全不同。

热烫依靠烫金版、温度、压力和停留时间，适合礼盒、酒盒、化妆品盒、书封、标签等需要高端质感的应用。冷烫通常通过印刷单元先上胶或 UV 胶，再把箔层转移到指定区域，适合标签、柔印、联线高速生产。Digital foil 通常和 MGI、Scodix、AccurioShine 等数字增效设备相关，要看设备胶层和指定耗材体系。Toner reactive foil 更偏办公或小批量 DIY，不适合直接等同于工业热烫膜。

如果客户问“为什么 UV inkjet 上烫金附着不好”，专业回答应先问：是热烫还是冷烫？底材是什么？UV 油墨或光油是否完全固化？是否做过表面张力测试？膜是否适配该胶/油墨体系？

# English Answer

In commercial printing, the word foil can refer to several different processes: traditional hot foil stamping, cold foil, digital foil, and toner reactive foil. These are not interchangeable systems.

Hot foil stamping uses a heated die, pressure, and dwell time. It is suitable for folding cartons, wine boxes, cosmetic boxes, book covers, labels, and premium packaging. Cold foil usually applies adhesive or UV adhesive first and transfers foil inline, often in flexo or label production. Digital foil is linked to digital embellishment systems such as MGI, Scodix, or AccurioShine and depends heavily on the machine’s adhesive/varnish system. Toner reactive foil is mainly for laser toner and laminator-based applications.

If a customer asks why foil does not adhere on UV inkjet, ask first: hot foil or cold foil? What substrate? Is the UV ink or varnish fully cured? What is the surface energy? Is the foil grade designed for that adhesive or ink system?
